notes: Categories now open on their own dedicated page with a back button, instead of stacking below the grid.
Settings restructured into a clean menu: Account, Appearance, Updates, Data & backup, Floating pen, and Help. Tap an item to open its specifics.
New Appearance options: compact lists and serif note titles.
Sign in / create account screen redesigned and clearer, with a proper message when the sync server cannot be reached right now.
More reliable signing in: the app now loads its sync library from a faster source and shows a friendly message instead of a raw 'failed to fetch'.
Removed unnecessary icons where they were not needed. Cleaner, easier-to-read screens throughout.
Easier navigation with the bottom bar: All, Categories, Review, Sessions, Settings.
Fixed the crash when turning off 'Show the floating pen'.
New: select text in any PDF or app, tap 'Note down' in the text toolbar, and the line lands in Marginalia to file under a category.
A loading screen appears while the app opens, then fades when your notes are ready. The app always loads the newest version when online.
